newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST-Tele Danmark 96 profit seen down.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Tele Danmark 96 profit seen down.

text.p: Nine analysts polled by Reuters in a survey issued on Friday foresaw nine percent lower 1996 pre-tax profits for Danish telecommunications group Tele Danmark.
The panel attributed the expected decline in profits mainly to multi-million-crown extraordinary costs of staging major marketing campaigns in Denmark to attract mobile telephone subscribers.

It forecast an average 1996 pre-tax profit for Tele Danmark of 4.955 billion crowns, 9.2 percent down on 1995, with net profits at an average 3.132 billion crowns, 10.4 percent lower than in the previous year.

Turnover was estimated at 23.995 billion crowns, 27.3 percent up on 1995, due partly to Tele Danmark's involvement in an international consortium owning 49.9 percent of Belgian telecoms operator Belgacom.
Tele Danmark is to announce its full-year 1996 results on Tuesday March 18.
Last August it posted first-half 1996 pre-tax results of 2.178 billion crowns and said full year net results might be lower than 1995's 3.494 billion crowns.
